payload.text: fleet's DEVBIN_FLEET_FROZEN MATCHES AN ESTATE'S LABEL since 0182 landed (3d170d3f, 2026-10-07): the name the plan's row prints, its path below this run's roots, which DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS changes. A basename freezes only an estate at a root's top level. A name that labels no estate this run could sweep, a basename for a nested estate among them, is printed as `matches none`, and --apply refuses while one is declared. Before any --apply, run the plan, copy each frozen name from its estate's row, and read the FROZEN rows, the summary's frozen count and that no `matches none` line is printed. Until 0182 the check read the basename (driven 2026-10-07), so a list written for an earlier sweep is rewritten by label.
